children: rose 4.43% premarket after Evercore ISI upgraded the language-learning company to Outperform from In Line with a $210 price
target, set at 20x 2028 EBITDA and implying more than 40% upside. The firm lifted its estimates alongside the call, putting 2027 and 2028 earnings per share 10% and 25% above consensus.

Evercore leaned on its own survey data, third-party tracking of quarter-to-date daily active user trends, channel checks, and a sensitivity analysis built around 100 million daily active users. It compared the current setup to Netflix in 2022, when the streaming company came out of a 70% drawdown with an ad-supported tier and a crackdown on password sharing. Duolingo is down about 50% over the past year.

DA Davidson upgraded to Buy at $160 on product and monetization improvements it argued the market was ignoring. Scotiabank cut its target to $120 from $130 at Sector Perform on a soft third quarter revenue outlook. Citizens stayed Market Perform on valuation. Duolingo separately disclosed that it had inadvertently shared a daily active user growth estimate at an in-person investor meeting, putting growth at 27.4% on August 17 against the same day a year earlier.

title: Evercore Sees Duolingo's 2022 Netflix Moment
